cues: Suppose you are told that B has happened.
Everything outside B is now impossible: B becomes the whole sample space.
The chance of A is now the part of A inside B, as a fraction of B.
text: Conditional probability. Suppose you are told that B has happened. Everything outside B is now impossible: B becomes the whole sample space. The chance of A is now the part of A inside B, as a fraction of B.
